verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair question for a creator e-commerce platform, but the evidence never documents a Gumroad feature that lets users set up autonomous background workflows. What exists is adjacent: app-connection integrations, automatic tax handling, recurring billing, an OAuth/MCP interface that agents drive on demand, and an internal Sidekiq worker. None of these is a user-configurable automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
